result.title: TEX: Test-Time Scaling Testing Agents via Execution-based Cross-Validation
result.summary: Test-case generation is critical but remains challenging for language models. Existing test-time scaling methods either isolate candidates or aggregate traces, which do not scale to long-horizon tasks. We present TEX, a collaborative test-time scaling framework based on execution-driven cross-validation. TEX parallelizes agents to generate tests and patches, cross-executing each test against every patch to form a $K \times K$ feedback matrix. Agents use their matrix slices for refinement, enabling objective validation without verbose trace sharing. On SWT-Bench Verified, TEX achieves 86.4%, establishing a new state-of-the-art and improving +9.0% over single-agent baselines. Moreover, even random selection from TEX outputs (84.4%) surpasses the previous SOTA (84.0%), showing collaborative execution feedback improves solution quality, not just best-case samples. Our results highlight execution-grounded feedback as an effective scaling mechanism for long-horizon agentic tasks.

AI.brief_summary: 针对测试用例生成这一长程任务，提出 TEX 协同式 test-time scaling 框架：并行 agent 分别生成测试与补丁，将每个测试与每个补丁交叉执行得到 K×K 反馈矩阵，各 agent 依据自己的矩阵切片迭代改进，在 SWT-Bench Verified 上取得 86.4%。
AI.relevance_reason: 「并行候选＋交叉执行」构成不依赖冗长轨迹共享的客观验证矩阵，可为 LVR 中多条 latent 假设与视觉证据的交叉核验、反馈聚合提供方法线索；但其客观判据来自可执行测试，视觉推理中能否构造等价验证信号尚待核查。
